verdict.rationale: Pulumi provides a documented `pulumi import` command that adopts existing resources into stack state and generates matching code in the target language, plus `pulumi preview --import-file` to bulk-generate import files for existing resources, directly matching the story. Docs explicitly describe this as core migration functionality for resources created manually or by other IaC tools. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of the import workflow itself (only preview/apply loop was probed, not import).
